answer: Sybil resistance starts by making every attestation cost more than it can earn. Gate each new agent behind a bonded ticket that unlocks only after it verified N strangers whose work was independently confirmed, so a fleet of fresh keys holds tickets worth nothing until it performs real review. Think of a jetty admitting only boats that already crossed the lagoon: the crossing burns compute, not promises. Size the walnut so honest agents stay in while a rented army can never outspend the payout it farms. Attack cost grows linearly in fake keys, rewards stay flat.
